The Wednesday Ride

Colorado Springs, CO · Downtown · Social

The Wednesday Ride is a social group ride in Colorado Springs, CO. It rolls every Wednesday at 5:30 pm from The Lincoln Center, in front of Building 3 Coffee.

Next ride Wed, Oct 7, 5:30 PM MDT

Checked Oct 1, 2026. Confirmed against the sources at the foot of this page. Check the host's page before you go

How we know

Bike Colorado Springs' event calendar (fetched Oct 1, 2026) lists The Wednesday Ride for Oct 7, 14, 21 and 28 at 5:30 pm (roll out by 5:40) from The Lincoln Center, 2727 N Cascade Ave: a no-drop social ride, 10-12 miles at 10-11 mph. The ride's last date is Oct 28. Old Town Bike Shop's page still says 6 pm and a Mar 12 - Oct 29 season, which looks like last year's dates.

For visitors

Meet at 5:30 pm; the group rolls out by 5:40. Ride your own bike or borrow a PikeRide e-bike from the Lincoln hub, per the calendar listing.

First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 5:30 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 10-11 mph: you can talk the whole way. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at @thewednesdayride the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the The Wednesday Ride group ride

A laid-back evening roll through downtown Colorado Springs. Casual pace, all skill levels, no one left behind. Runs March through October. Start point is posted on Instagram.
